_comment: Written by scripts/regen-src-golden.mjs (#91). `sha256` must match tests/fixtures/src-bundle.golden.js — tests/src-bundle-parity.test.ts enforces it, so a hand-edited golden, or one regenerated by any means that skips the reason prompt, fails the gate.
reason: #235 (code-review finding): MAZ.ts was a fourth sink of the same class and the largest — 29 splices of autoTrimpSettings[...].value[x] into SINGLE-quoted attributes reaching innerHTML across the 14 preset editors. Escaping would not have closed it (escapeHtml does not escape a single quote), so the value attributes are removed and the row values are written as DOM properties via setRowFieldValue; the three inert select value= attributes are dropped outright.
